service_name.description: Name of the service or script wrapper.

mode.description: The operation mode for the psl command. Options: is-public-suffix, is-cookie-domain-acceptable, print-unreg-domain, print-reg-domain.

data_source.description: The source of Public Suffix data. Options: use-latest-data, use-builtin-data, load-psl-file.

psl_file_path.description: Path to a custom PSL data file. Required only if data_source is load-psl-file.

domains.description: List of domains to process with the psl command.

cookie_domain.description: The cookie domain to check against, used only when mode is is-cookie-domain-acceptable.
